Choose Choose Choose Contact FAQ Billing, credits and plan changes. What are credits and how do they work? + Credits are a dollar-denominated balance used to pay for usage across all Inworld products. When you subscribe to a paid plan, you receive credits equal to your plan price at the start of each billing cycle. For example, the Developer plan ($300/mo) grants $300 in monthly credits. As you use Inworld products, usage is metered and deducted from your credit balance at your tier's rates. Higher tiers unlock lower per-unit rates and higher rate limits across various features/products. How is LLM Inference priced? + LLM Inference bills per token from the same credits as every other product. Open models we host, such as Gemma 4, GLM and DeepSeek, start at $0.07 per 1M input tokens, and cached input costs up to 99% less. MiMo 2.6 Pro: cached input $0.0036 against $0.43 input, per 1M tokens Every model's rates are on the models page. Do unused credits roll over? + Unused subscription credits roll over automatically for up to 3 months, as long as you have an active paid subscription and a plan of equal or higher value. Each month's credit grant has its own 3-month window before it expires. For example, if you have $50 unused from January, that $50 expires at the end of March. What happens if I go over my credits? + You can purchase additional credits or enable auto-reload to automatically add credits when your balance drops below a threshold you set. These credits are billed at your current tier's rates and expire after 1 year from purchase. They are not subject to monthly expiration or ro ... 40% off rates, and 3,000 custom voices. Developer is for production apps; you get up to 47% off rates, 10,000 custom voices, and priority email support. Growth is for high-volume production use-cases; it offers up to 53% off rates, even higher API limits, 30,000 custom voices, and compliance add-ons. Enterprise is fully custom with rates as low as $5/1M chars on Realtime TTS-2. Contact sales . Start building On-Demand includes up to 70 minutes of TTS, so you can try every product before you pick a plan.
